description: The exact-title publication describes modular smart contracts with dynamic voting thresholds for validating reported road closures and construction events. Incentives are assigned when consensus is reached. A Hardhat simulation on an Ethereum-compatible test network evaluates the method. This is a documented road-information coordination model, not a verified production data-sharing platform or an existing road-event dataset. Code and deployment availability remain unknown. The source authors provide the native description and file descriptors through Zenodo. Only metadata was inspected; no measurements, archives, source code or document bodies were retrieved. Public access and the deposit document licence do not establish executable access, software reuse rights or operating costs. Coverage remains bounded to the named experiments, with other geographic and temporal fields unknown. Related project resources may overlap; common project membership does not establish identical simulation inputs or results.
